$comment: The mcp-use cursor format (D49, PLAN §8.8.2): c1.<epoch: 12 [a-z0-9]>.<seq: base36>.<mac: 16 base64url>, mac = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(cursorKey, 'c1\0' + name + '\0' + epoch + '\0' + seq))[0..16]. Cursors are opaque to clients; the codec is server-only. This file pins the format so other implementations and tests can recognize an mcp-use cursor. A c2. prefix would be a new, additive format.
